Tool: built-in imagegen. New asset, not an edit. Transparent background: false.
Purpose: backdrop texture for the windows of the Mongolian grocery game.
Project asset: dist/assets/environment/city-dusk.png

Prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a wide panoramic exterior backdrop texture for the windows of a warm, cozy 3D Mongolian neighborhood grocery game. Generate only the exterior city scenery, not a store interior, not a screenshot. A beautiful layered Ulaanbaatar-inspired cityscape at blue hour: mid-rise apartment buildings, a few slender modern high-rises, hazy rolling Mongolian mountain ridges far behind, a softly glowing peach-pink dusk horizon under dusty lavender-blue sky. Many small warm amber lit apartment windows, subtle streetlights and quiet evening life far below. Premium hand-painted realistic game background with detailed architectural textures, soft atmospheric perspective, rich restrained color, calm inviting mood, luminous but not neon. Composition: very wide landscape panorama, approximately 3:1, camera around second-floor height with level horizon, skyline occupying the lower two thirds and open twilight sky in upper third. Buildings medium-distance, no single iconic landmark dominating. Image will be seen through several tall shop windows; keep visual interest across the entire width. Do not include any shop windows, window frames, glass, borders, room, products, people in foreground, text, logos, or watermarks. Avoid oversaturated orange, black shadows, comic outlines, futuristic towers and snow.
